events.title: Global Payments Bets On AI Handhelds And Embedded Deals In Restaurants
events.body: Global Payments (NYSE:GPN) introduced an AI first Genius handheld POS device and new kiosk solutions at the National Restaurant Association Show. The company renewed and expanded embedded payments partnerships, including with Lightspeed DMS

events.title: Global Payments Enhances Restaurant Tech Portfolio With AI POS Launch
events.body: GPN introduces an AI-powered Genius handheld POS with voice ordering, offline payments and kiosk support for restaurants.

events.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Fiserv and Global Payments
events.body: Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Fiserv and Global Payments have been highlighted in this Industry Outlook article.
